from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib
root=Path("/workspace/scratch/b6252d122d78/compass-c/evals/dogfood/v4-lifecycle/run-1/resume")
def record(name):
    return json.loads((root/name).read_text())
def payload(name):
    return json.loads(record(name)["stdout"])
before=payload("08-before-preview-hashes.json")
after=payload("11-after-preview-hashes.json")
pre=payload("09-before-preview-state.json")["data"]
post=payload("12-after-preview-state.json")["data"]
apply=payload("13-observation-apply.json")["data"]
lineage=payload("15-full-plan-lineage.json")["data"]
original=payload("06-recovered-full-plan.json")["data"]
check_record=record("07-bounded-check.json")
check=json.loads(check_record["stdout"])
observation=record("observation.json")
facts={
"preview_database_files_unchanged": before["files"]==after["files"],
"preview_revision_before":pre["revision"],
"preview_revision_after":post["revision"],
"preview_remained_pending":pre["status"]==post["status"]=="awaiting_observation",
"preview_posterior_not_persisted":pre["current_model_note_id"]==post["current_model_note_id"],
"apply_revision":apply["revision"],
"apply_applied":apply["applied"],
"apply_replayed":apply["replayed"],
"readback_revision":lineage["revision"],
"readback_status":lineage["status"],
"no_pending_proposal":lineage["summary"]["proposed_experiment_ids"]==[],
"single_observation_consumed":lineage["summary"]["single_observation_consumed"],
"frozen_parameters_preserved":original["parameters"]==lineage["parameters"],
"retained_observation_matches":observation==lineage["observation"]["update"]["result"]["observation"],
"event_identity_matches":record("event-identity.json")["event_id"]==lineage["observation"]["event_id"]==apply["event_id"],
"actual_check_exit_status":check_record["exit_status"],
"actual_check_timed_out":check_record["timed_out"],
"actual_check_outcome":check["outcome"],
"actual_check_case_count":len(check["cases"]),
"actual_check_all_cases_passed":all(case["passed"] for case in check["cases"]),
"actual_check_capture_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"07-bounded-check.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
"observation_sha256":hashlib.sha256((root/"observation.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
"model_lineage":{"prior":lineage["model_note_id"],"outcome":apply["outcome_note_id"],"posterior":lineage["current_model_note_id"]},
"general_brief_status":payload("14-resulting-brief.json")["data"]["review"]["status"]
}
print(json.dumps(facts,indent=2))
